full-pack.What’s Inside:
Flashcards & Learning Resources

●	160 waterproof flashcards, including indexes and instructions

●	Divided into 8 learning categories:

        ○	Folder 1: Water Adaptation

	○	Folder 2: Floating & Streamlining, Water Safety

	○	Folder 3: Swimming Strokes, Diving, Turns & Starts

	○	Folder 4: Games, Toys & Equipment, Extras

●	4 colour-coded folders to organise flashcards by category

●	1 Session Plan Folder to support structured and flexible lesson planning

Poolside Tools & Accessories

●	Swimming Stands & Holder (white bag): 3 stands (First, Next, Then) and a holder for clear poolside routines

●	 Swimming Toys (yellow bag): 3 ducks, 1 water pistol, 1 pop tube, 1 bucket, 1 ball, plus additional interactive items

●	Additional items: 1 blue session bag, 1 marker, 1 blue spear bag, and 1 microfibre towel
